correctness.rationale: The tridiagonal generator differs from rho times its rho=1 Neumann generator plus a scalar shift by exactly two endpoint rank-one terms. DCT-II conjugation turns those terms into two boundary vectors whose parity signs cancel all cross-parity coupling, yielding two exact diagonal-plus-rank-one blocks. The odd DCT-VI/DCT-VIII form follows from the standard odd DCT-II parity split, and numerical checks agree to roundoff.

originality.rationale: The recent fixed-core source arXiv:2609.20221 states and proves its diagonal-plus-rank-one factorization only for even order. The all-order source arXiv:2608.06522 treats odd order with recursive residual KLTs and an arrowhead stage. Searches found no published odd-order fixed-DCT rank-one completion; originality is asserted only to the best of our knowledge and simultaneous-work risk is explicitly retained.

value.rationale: The result supplies a uniform nonrecursive factorization for every transform length and removes the residual-KLT recursion and arrowhead from the odd-order representation, while preserving the same Cauchy-structured correction primitive used in the even case. The gain is structural rather than asymptotic.
